title: Модальность: might well, may as well, could hardly, would sooner

why: Эти модальные выражения передают тонкие оттенки: «вполне возможно», «можно и...», «едва ли», «я бы скорее...». В русском это решают слова «вполне», «пожалуй», «едва», «лучше уж». В английском для каждого оттенка есть своя формула.
formation: • may / might / could well + V1 (вполне возможно): She may well refuse.
• may / might as well + V1 (можно и..., с таким же успехом): We might as well go.
• might as well have + V3 (зря не сделали иначе): We might as well have stayed home.
• can / could hardly + V1 (едва, вряд ли): I could hardly hear him.
• could hardly have + V3 (едва ли мог): He could hardly have known.
• would sooner / would rather + V1 (+ than + V1): I'd sooner stay than go.
• would rather / sooner + подлежащее + Past Simple (про другого человека): I'd rather you didn't.
usage: 1. Высокая вероятность: The release may well be postponed. (Релиз вполне может быть отложен.)
2. Нет причин отказываться: There's nothing to do, so we may as well leave. (Делать нечего, так что можем и уйти.)
3. Почти невозможно: I can hardly believe it. (Я едва в это верю.) Hardly уже отрицание, поэтому not не нужен.
4. Предпочтение: I would sooner work alone than in a team. (Я бы скорее работал один, чем в команде.)
5. Просьба к другому человеку: I'd rather you didn't smoke here. (Я бы предпочёл, чтобы вы здесь не курили.) Форма Past Simple, но смысл настоящий.
signalWords: well, as well, hardly, sooner, rather, than; «вполне», «можно и», «едва», «скорее чем», «лучше бы».
mistakes: ✗ She might good be right. → ✓ She might well be right. (well, а не good)
✗ I would sooner to stay. → ✓ I would sooner stay. (после would sooner — V1 без to)
✗ I can't hardly hear you. → ✓ I can hardly hear you. (двойное отрицание)
✗ I'd rather you don't tell him. → ✓ I'd rather you didn't tell him. (про другого человека — Past Simple)
✗ They might well to win. → ✓ They might well win. (после модального глагола to не нужен)
remember: well — вероятно, as well — «можно и», hardly — «едва», sooner — «скорее»; после всех — V1 без to.

items.prompt: He is late again; he ___ well be stuck in traffic.
items.answer: may / might / could

items.prompt: There's nothing on TV, so we ___ as well go to bed.
items.answer: may / might

items.prompt: I could ___ believe my eyes.
items.answer: hardly

items.prompt: I'd sooner ___ (stay) home than go to that party.
items.answer: stay

items.prompt: She would ___ walk than take the bus.
items.answer: rather / sooner

items.prompt: It's so noisy that I can ___ hear you.
items.answer: hardly

items.prompt: The train was so late that we ___ as well have taken a taxi.
items.answer: might / may

items.prompt: I'd sooner you ___ (not, tell) anyone.
items.answer: didn't tell

items.prompt: It ___ rain tonight. (a) might well (b) might good
items.answer: (a) might well

items.prompt: We ___ ask him. (a) may as well (b) may as good
items.answer: (a) may as well

items.prompt: I could ___ in that room. (a) hardly not breathe (b) hardly breathe
items.answer: (b) hardly breathe

items.prompt: I ___ leave early than wait. (a) would sooner to (b) would sooner
items.answer: (b) would sooner

items.prompt: He ___ known the answer. (a) could hardly have (b) couldn't hardly have
items.answer: (a) could hardly have

items.prompt: I'd rather ___ smoke here. (a) you didn't (b) you don't
items.answer: (a) you didn't

items.prompt: The result ___ a surprise. (a) may well be (b) may well to be
items.answer: (a) may well be

items.prompt: I ___ for the weekend. (a) can hardly wait (b) hardly can wait
items.answer: (a) can hardly wait

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: It is quite possible that she knows the answer. (may well)
items.answer: She may well know the answer.

items.prompt: I prefer to work alone rather than in a team. (would sooner)
items.answer: I would sooner work alone than in a team.

items.prompt: I almost couldn't hear him. (could hardly)
items.answer: I could hardly hear him.

items.prompt: We have nothing else to do, so there is no reason not to start now. (might as well)
items.answer: We might as well start now.

items.prompt: It's very likely that they missed the train. (might well have)
items.answer: They might well have missed the train.

items.prompt: I don't want you to read my messages. (would rather)
items.answer: I would rather you didn't read my messages.

items.prompt: The meeting was useless; staying at home would have been just as good. (might as well have)
items.answer: We might as well have stayed at home.

items.prompt: I would prefer to pay now than later. (would sooner)
items.answer: I would sooner pay now than later.

items.prompt: She might good be right.
items.answer: She might well be right.

items.prompt: I would sooner to stay at home.
items.answer: I would sooner stay at home.

items.prompt: I can't hardly hear you.
items.answer: I can hardly hear you.

items.prompt: I'd rather you don't tell him.
items.answer: I'd rather you didn't tell him.

items.prompt: We may as good wait here.
items.answer: We may as well wait here.

items.prompt: He would sooner going than waiting.
items.answer: He would sooner go than wait.

items.prompt: They might well to win the match.
items.answer: They might well win the match.

items.prompt: I could hardly not understand him because he spoke so fast.
items.answer: I could hardly understand him because he spoke so fast.

items.prompt: Он, вполне возможно, откажется.
items.answer: He may well refuse. / He might well refuse.

items.prompt: Нам нечего делать, так что можем и пойти домой.
items.answer: We have nothing to do, so we may as well go home. / We have nothing to do, so we might as well go home.

items.prompt: Я едва слышал её из-за шума.
items.answer: I could hardly hear her because of the noise.

items.prompt: Я бы лучше остался дома, чем пошёл туда.
items.answer: I would sooner stay home than go there. / I would rather stay home than go there.

items.prompt: Я бы предпочёл, чтобы ты не говорил об этом клиенту.
items.answer: I would rather you didn't mention this to the client.

items.prompt: Релиз вполне может быть отложен.
items.answer: The release may well be postponed. / The release might well be postponed.

items.prompt: Мы с таким же успехом могли бы поехать на поезде.
items.answer: We might as well have taken the train.

items.prompt: Едва ли он мог знать об этом.
items.answer: He could hardly have known about it.
